name: RedSky
source: You play as an 18-year-old boy who wants to go to college. Still, his plan changes when a mysterious event happens in town, be hard choices to make, but will you make them, his life Will change for good /bad there will be a dark/happy time when you go into the story.
translation: 你将扮演一名怀揣大学梦的18岁少年。然而镇上突发的一桩神秘事件打乱了他的求学计划。面对接踵而至的艰难抉择，你究竟会如何取舍？随着你一步步深入故事，他的人生将由此走向光明抑或深渊，迎来或黑暗或欢愉的未知时光。
